town_description: Tinsukia is a commercial town and the headquarters of Tinsukia district in Upper Assam, about 50 km northeast of Dibrugarh. Its best-known shrine is the Tilinga (Bell) Mandir, and it sits amid tea country near Dibru-Saikhowa National Park.
